requests.rejectSub: The reason will be visible to the requester in their request history.
requests.rejectReasonPlaceholder: E.g.: duplicate of an existing structure…
requests.approveChainHint: Approving will also create the “to create” parents of the chain.

joinRequests.title: Join requests
joinRequests.intro: Requests to join an assembly submitted from the apps. Approving attaches the requester (creating the assembly first if it is “to create”); rejecting requires a reason shared with the requester.
joinRequests.approveCreateHint: Approving will first create the “to create” assembly, then attach the requester.
joinRequests.emptyHint: Join requests submitted from the mobile or web app will appear here.
joinRequests.rejectSub: The reason will be visible to the requester in their request history.
joinRequests.rejectReasonPlaceholder: E.g.: wrong assembly, request to redo…

ministries.title: Ministries
ministries.intro: A ministry brings together all localities under a single spiritual and administrative authority. Creating a ministry generates its first contact (Secretariat role) and an invitation link to send so they can activate their account.
ministries.createSub: Creates the ministry, its first locality and its referent contact (invitation).
ministries.createdSub: The referent contact will activate their account via this link (password to set). Link valid for 14 days.
ministries.invitationLinkHint: To send to the contact (out of band: email, message…)

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.modulesIntro: Goals and Songbooks are free (always active). Donations and Member Care are paid (managed by subscription).
subscriptions.createSub: Activates one or more paid modules for an entity (downward inheritance to all its descendants).
subscriptions.noPayableModules: No paid module in the catalog.
subscriptions.pickMinistryHint: Select a ministry to manage its subscriptions across its tree.
subscriptions.noOrg: This ministry has no structure yet (countries, zones, units).

teachingModules.title: Teaching modules
teachingModules.intro: Teaching modules are specific to each ministry and shared by all its assemblies: each assembly follows them at its own pace in its meeting reports. A deactivated module is no longer offered for entry but stays visible in the history; a chapter already read can no longer be removed, only renamed. For the assembly study, a module has a code and a prerequisite, each chapter (lesson) a portion and its questions; an imported module (JSON) starts deactivated and is activated after review. This catalogue is shared by two modules: “Assembly life” (chapters read, recorded in meeting reports) and “Bertoua message” (study sessions, one lesson = one chapter).
teachingModules.empty: No teaching module yet. Click “New module”.
teachingModules.createSub: The module will be offered to every assembly of the selected ministry.
teachingModules.bookPlaceholder: e.g. The house church in God's eternal purposes
teachingModules.quickEntryHint: Generates the chapters in the range; titles already entered are kept, and so are chapters already read.
teachingModules.noChaptersYet: No chapters. Use quick entry or add one.
teachingModules.cannotRemoveRead: Chapter already read in a meeting: it can no longer be removed (only renamed).
teachingModules.errNoChapters: At least one chapter is required.
teachingModules.errInvalidNumber: Each chapter needs a whole number ≥ 1.
teachingModules.errDuplicateNumber: Two chapters have the same number.
teachingModules.errChapterAlreadyRead: A chapter already read in a meeting or studied in a session cannot be removed. The chapters were not changed.
teachingModules.errFieldRequired: Module name and book title are required.
teachingModules.structureHint: Check if the book is divided into parts: chapter numbering then restarts at 1 in each part.
teachingModules.structureLocked: Some chapters have already been read in a meeting: the structure (with or without parts) can no longer change.
teachingModules.cannotRemoveReadPart: A chapter of this part has already been read: it can no longer be removed or renumbered.
teachingModules.errNoParts: At least one part is required.
teachingModules.errInvalidPartNumber: Each part needs a whole number ≥ 1.
teachingModules.errDuplicatePartNumber: Two parts have the same number.
teachingModules.cannotRemoveStudied: Lesson already studied in a session: it can no longer be removed (only renamed).
teachingModules.questionsNewChapter: Save the module to add questions to this chapter.
teachingModules.questionsSaveFirst: Chapter numbering changed: save the module before editing the questions.
teachingModules.codeHint: Optional; unique within the ministry for a given language (capital letters and digits recommended). The English version of a unit has the same code.
teachingModules.prerequisiteHint: An assembly can open a lesson of this module only after finishing every lesson of the prerequisite.
teachingModules.errCodeExists: This code already exists in this language for this ministry. Another language is possible (same code, FR / EN version).
teachingModules.errPrerequisiteInvalid: Invalid prerequisite: it must belong to the same ministry, be another module and not create a cycle.
teachingModules.contentInvalidIntro: The module cannot be activated while these questions are inconsistent. Fix them in their lesson's editor (“Questions”), then activate again:

import.title: Import a study unit
import.sub: Creates a new deactivated module, one lesson per entry of the file, with its questions.
import.fileHint: Contract format (code, name, bookTitle, language, lessons[]). The module is created deactivated: review the questions, then activate it.
import.errNotJson: This file is not valid JSON.
import.errShape: The file must contain an object with a non-empty “lessons” list.

questions.activeHint: Active module: saving is refused while any question is inconsistent.
questions.draftHint: Module deactivated: imperfect content is accepted; the reported inconsistencies must be fixed before activation.
questions.empty: No questions yet. Add the first one.
questions.ungradedHint: Exercises and instructions are not graded.
questions.parentLockedHint: This question has sub-questions: it stays a main question.
questions.cannotRemoveAnswered: Question already answered in a session: it can no longer be removed (only edited).
questions.strayKeys: Answer keys without a matching option:
questions.expectedAnswerOptionalLabel: Answer or note from the manual (optional)
questions.issuesStale: Checked at the last save: save to check again.
questions.errDuplicateNumber: Two questions have the same number in the lesson.
questions.errPoints: Points: a number ≥ 0, with at most 2 decimals.
questions.errAnswered: A question already answered in a session cannot be removed. Nothing was saved.
questions.errParentInvalid: Invalid sub-question: its main question must exist in the lesson and not be a sub-question itself.

teachingModules.languageHint: The FR and EN versions of a unit share its code: a member's progress is counted by code.
teachingModules.moduleLeaderNotesHint: Shown only to the assembly leader before the unit's first lesson.
teachingModules.lessonLeaderNotesHint: Shown only to the assembly leader before starting the lesson.
teachingModules.memberActionsHint: One action per line ({{max}} at most) — shown to everyone once the session is finished.
teachingModules.notesToggleTitle: Recommendations for the leader and member actions
teachingModules.errLeaderNotesTooLong: Recommendations too long (10,000 characters at most).
teachingModules.errTooManyActions: 30 member actions at most per lesson.

eventTypes.title: Event types
eventTypes.intro: Event types are specific to each ministry: members and leaders pick them to report an action or schedule an event. Only completed events of an evangelism type count in the evangelism statistics. A type already in use cannot be deleted: deactivate it instead — it is no longer offered for entry and the history stays intact.
eventTypes.empty: No event type yet. Click “New type”.
eventTypes.emptyMinistry: This ministry has no event type: without one, nothing can be reported. Create them before enabling the Events module for it.
eventTypes.inUseHint: Type used by at least one event: it can no longer be deleted, only deactivated.
eventTypes.createSub: The type will be offered for entry in every assembly of the selected ministry.
eventTypes.nameEnHint: Optional: the French label is shown when missing.
eventTypes.codeHint: Technical key, unique within the ministry: capital letters, digits and “_”. Suggested from the label.
eventTypes.codeEditHint: Technical key, unique within the ministry: capital letters, digits and “_”. Can be changed: events reference the type, not its code.
eventTypes.orderHint: Empty: placed after the existing types.
eventTypes.evangelismHint: Completed events of this type count in the evangelism statistics. Uncheck for a ministry-life event (regional service, seminar…): it stays in the agenda but is not counted.
eventTypes.evangelismRetroactive: This type is already in use: changing this setting retroactively changes the statistics of all its events.
eventTypes.requiresLabelHint: For an “Other” type: whoever reports must describe the action in a few words. Applies to future entries only.
eventTypes.errCodeExists: This code is already used by another type of this ministry.
eventTypes.errCodeInvalid: The code may only contain unaccented capital letters, digits and “_”.
eventTypes.errOrderInvalid: The order must be a whole number between 0 and {{max}}.
eventTypes.errInUse: This type is already used by at least one event: it cannot be deleted, the history and statistics depend on it.
eventTypes.errNotFound: This type or ministry no longer exists. The list has been reloaded.
eventTypes.deleteWarning: No event uses this type: it will be permanently removed from the ministry's catalogue.
eventTypes.deactivateExplain: Deactivate it instead: it will no longer be offered for entry, and past events stay intact and counted.
eventTypes.alreadyInactive: It is already deactivated: it is no longer offered for entry, and past events stay intact.

documents.title: Documents
documents.intro: PDFs shared through a universal link: recipients read a preview (the first pages) in their browser and the rest in the Shephr app. A document is filed at one level of the ministry (whole ministry, a nation, a region, a city or an assembly) and in a folder (three levels at most). It is reachable by link only once published, and only if its ministry has the Documents module.
documents.empty: No document yet. Click “Upload a PDF”.
documents.unavailableModuleHint: The link answers “no longer available”: the ministry (or the level the document is filed at) has no active subscription to the Documents module.
documents.copyFailTitle: Could not copy — copy the link manually
documents.linkAvailable: The link is live: it opens the app when installed, otherwise the preview in the browser.
documents.linkUnpublished: Unpublished document: the link answers “no longer available”. Republish to bring it back (same link).
documents.linkExpired: The expiry date has passed: the link answers “no longer available”.
documents.noLinkYet: The link is created on first publication.
documents.statsHint: Totals since creation, across all versions and links. Anonymous measurement: no IP address is stored.
documents.createStep1: Step 1 of 2 — the PDF, its description and where it is filed.
documents.createStep2: Step 2 of 2 — the PDF has {{pages}} pages: set the free preview, then publish.
documents.publishedHint: Share this link: it opens the Shephr app when installed, otherwise the preview in the browser.
documents.fileHint: PDF only, 50 MB at most, not password-protected.
documents.descriptionHint: Optional: shown under the title and in the link's WhatsApp preview.
documents.scopeHint: Where the document is filed in the app's Documents space: it is visible at this level and below. The link itself can be read by anyone.
documents.scopeLoadError: Could not load the ministry structure.
documents.freePagesHint: Number of first pages readable without the app.
documents.freePagesAll: All pages are free: the preview shows the whole document, with no wall.
documents.expiresAtHint: Optional: after this date, the link answers “no longer available”.
documents.openLabel: Open document (readable in full everywhere, no wall)
documents.openHint: The full PDF is served on the web as in the app; free pages no longer apply.
documents.replaceExplain: The link stays the same: people who received it will see the new version. Preview and thumbnail are recomputed; if the new PDF has fewer pages than the free preview, the preview is reduced to the page count.

unpublish.title: Unpublish document
unpublish.body: The link will answer “This document is no longer available” until you republish it. Republishing brings back the same link.

regenerate.title: Regenerate link
regenerate.body: The old link will stop working: everyone who received it will see “This document is no longer available”. A new link will be assigned.

delete.title: Delete document
delete.body: The document disappears from the back-office and the app, and its link will answer “no longer available”. Audience statistics are kept. This cannot be undone.

folders.orderEditHint: Position among the folders of the same level.
folders.orderInvalid: The order must be a whole number between 0 and {{max}}.

folders.moveCycle: Not possible: this is the folder itself or one of its subfolders.

structure.title: Structure
structure.pickMinistryHint: Select a ministry to build its structure (countries, zones, localities, units).
structure.deleteWarning: This deletion is permanent and only possible if the item has no sub-items.
structure.detachWarning: These people will be detached from their assembly and will appear in the “accounts without an assembly” tab of Users, where you can reassign or delete them. Their pledges follow them.
structure.name: Name
structure.regionLabelHint: "Region" (e.g. Cameroon) or "State" (e.g. USA) — applies to every region of this nation.
structure.languageHint: Language of the assembly: the study catalogue first offers it the units in this language.

responsables.title: Leaders
responsables.assignHint: Search for a user of this ministry. If they already hold this role at the same level (city leader, senior leader), this attachment will be added to theirs; otherwise their current attachment (Goals module) will be replaced.
responsables.supervisorHint: Position in the org chart (who this person reports to).
responsables.codeSaved: Code shown on the card — copy and send it.
responsables.deleteWarning: The account will be removed from the database. Irreversible. Not possible if they supervise others or have linked data (donations, goals…).
responsables.reassignHint: Pick the new hierarchical level, the attachment entity and the supervisor. The previous attachment is replaced.
responsables.homeAssemblyHint: The assembly where this person declares THEIR OWN objectives — distinct from the position held here. Required for every Objectives role, coordinators and secretariat included.

users.title: Users
users.pickMinistryHint: Select a ministry to view and manage its users.
users.searchScopeHint: Search spans your whole perimeter — geographic filters are ignored.
users.multiEntityHint: Multiple selections allowed — the first one (★) is the primary attachment. Click a badge to remove it.
users.pwHint: At least 6 characters. Share it with the person.
users.deleteWarning: Permanent deletion from the database. Blocked if a zone/unit the person leads would be left without any other leader (reassign first), or if data is linked.
users.roleMinistryWideHint: Ministry-wide role: no geographic attachment (global view).
users.roleHint: The attachment is reset as a block according to the role (Assembly, City, Region or Nation) — the previous attachment is replaced. The supervisor defines the org chart.
users.usernameHint: Identifier assigned by the back office
users.emailOptionalHint: Leave empty if the person has no email — the account works with the identifier alone.
users.createNeedsMinistry: Pick a ministry first to create an account in it.
users.createSub: The account is created inactive: the person sets their own password using the activation code.
users.createHint: The supervisor defines the position in the org chart — that is what determines what the person sees, not the geographic attachment.
users.createdToastMsg: Send the activation code to the person.
users.entityOptionalHint: Optional at this level: the role can be granted without a region, city or nation, and the attachment set later.
users.codeHint: Send this code to the person. They enter it in the app to choose a password and activate their account.
users.codeExpiry: Single use, valid for 14 days. Can be regenerated from the Structure page if needed.
users.homeAssemblyHint: The assembly where this person declares THEIR OWN objectives — distinct from the entity they lead. Required for every Objectives role, coordinators, leaders and secretariat included.
users.transferWarning: Changing the assembly moves the person: their objectives follow them, past years included. The former assembly's total goes down, the new one's goes up.
users.goalSubmittedNullHint: Account with no home assembly, or platform administrator.
users.submissionCounterHint: Across the whole filtered scope, not just the page shown.
users.goalsEmpty: No objectives declared. An objective is personal: the person enters it themselves from their app.
users.unlockHint: Unlocking reopens the year: the person corrects it themselves from their app.
users.unattachedHint: Objectives accounts with no home assembly: they can neither declare nor be counted. Attach them — the row then leaves this list.
users.correctHint: You are writing on the person's behalf. The correction goes through even when the objective is locked, and does not unlock it; the original declarant stays unchanged.
users.correctNeedsAssembly: This account has no home assembly: attach it first (“Without assembly” tab or the Role action), then the correction becomes possible.
users.correctYearClosed: Year {{year}} is not open for declarations: nobody can write into it, secretariat included. Reopen the year first.
users.correctedToastMsg: The value has been saved for that person.

billing.title: Invoicing
billing.intro: Paid subscriptions taken out on the public page, monthly invoices, offers and promo codes. Payment never opens a module: module access is still managed in “Subscriptions”.

subs.cancelBody: At the end of the paid period ({{date}}), the subscription stops with no further charge. Immediate cancellation stops it right away. The status is updated when the Stripe event arrives. No module is cut off.
subs.cancelRequestedHint: The status will be updated when the Stripe event arrives.

invoices.periodHint: Dates in the Paris time zone. The CSV export uses the selected period (all invoices if empty).
invoices.resentToast: Invoice email resent to the payer

offers.hint: An archived offer is no longer offered; existing subscriptions keep their price.
offers.name: Name
offers.v1Hint: Only euros and monthly billing are accepted for now.
offers.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and “-”, 3 to 40 characters. Cannot be changed later.
offers.priceFrozenHint: Changing the price never changes an existing subscription: its price is frozen at sign-up.

promo.hint: A code reduces the price by a percentage for the whole life of the subscription, whatever the offer.
promo.label: Label
promo.deleteBody: The code will be deleted permanently. A code already used cannot be deleted: disable it instead.
promo.formHint: The discount applies to every month of the subscription.
promo.codeHint: Uppercase letters, digits and “-”, 4 to 32 characters. Cannot be changed later.

errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts: try again in a minute.
errors.PAYMENT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The payment provider (Stripe) is not configured or not responding.
